secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Session/auth token signing key used by the Next.js API routes.

secrets.name: DATABASE_URL
secrets.description: Postgres connection string for raw SQL paths (pg). Optional: the Supabase-compat data layer is lazy and the app boots without it.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL for the Prisma-compat data layer (optional; queries fail lazily when absent).

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key used server-side by the data layer.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase URL exposed to the browser client.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anonymous key exposed to the browser client.

secrets.name: NCBDB_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: NoCodeBackend API token used by vps/junaikey memory backends.

secrets.name: NCBDB_PROJECT_ID
secrets.description: NoCodeBackend project/instance id used by vps/junaikey.

secrets.name: OMNIMASTER_KEY
secrets.description: OmniMasterKey secret used by Junaikey secret access.
